newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK govt paper yields lower,tracing U.S. treasuries.
newsitem.headline: HK govt paper yields lower,tracing U.S. treasuries.

text.p: Hong Kong government paper yields slipped on Friday in line with overnight moves by U.S. treasuries, dealers said.

Yields of 10-year Exchange Fund notes dipped to 7.25 percent from 7.31 at Thursday's midsession, while the seven-year eased to 6.97 percent from 7.01. Five-year notes yielded 6.66 percent versus 6.70, and three-year notes 6.13 percent versus 6.16.
The U.S. long bond rose 1-2/32 on Thursday, bringing the yield down to a fresh eight-month low of 6.54 percent.
Yields of one-week Exchange Fund bills were steady at 4.84 percent versus 4.85.
